description: This file defines an Angular component for uploading trace files, handling drag-and-drop and file selection, displaying upload progress, managing loaded trace files, and providing UI interactions for viewing or clearing traces.

classes.name: UploadTracesComponent
classes.description: Angular component facilitating trace file uploads with UI controls and progress handling.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes component, clearing existing trace pipeline data.

methods.name: onProgressUpdate
methods.description: Updates upload progress UI based on progress listener events.

methods.name: onOperationFinished
methods.description: Resets loading state after upload completes.

methods.name: onInputFiles
methods.description: Handles file selection via input element and emits files for processing.

methods.name: onViewTracesButtonClick
methods.description: Emits event to trigger trace viewing.

methods.name: onClearButtonClick
methods.description: Clears loaded traces from pipeline and updates UI.

methods.name: onFileDragIn
methods.description: Handles drag enter event for file drop area.

methods.name: onFileDragOut
methods.description: Handles drag leave event for file drop area.

methods.name: onHandleFileDrop
methods.description: Handles files dropped into the drop area, emitting files for upload.

methods.name: getInputFiles
methods.description: Extracts File objects from input event.

ctags.name: files
ctags.pattern: /^    const files: FileList | null = (event?.target as HTMLInputElement)?.files;$/
